name: File scanning branches to storage or quarantine

history.speaker: Jordan
history.text: The Upload API sends every file to the Virus scanner.

history.speaker: Riley
history.text: If the scanner says the file is clean, it goes to Object storage.

history.speaker: Casey
history.text: If it finds malware, send the file to Quarantine instead.

history.speaker: Jordan
history.text: Object storage then notifies the Indexer so the clean file becomes searchable.

history.speaker: Riley
history.text: Right, files in Quarantine must never go straight into Object storage.

summary:
### Conclusions
- The Upload API sends files to the Virus scanner (Board 1).
- Clean files go to Object storage after passing the Virus scanner (Board 1).
- Malware files are sent to Quarantine instead of Object storage (Board 1).
- Object storage notifies the Indexer so clean files become searchable (Board 1).
- Files in Quarantine must never go directly to Object storage (Board 1).
